name: recovery-codes-section
title: Recovery codes section
description: Recovery codes shown once with copy, download and print, and a checkbox people must tick to confirm they saved them before they can continue.
docs: Codes of any length work: they sit two to a row while the longest fits and one to a row when it does not. Pass plain strings for fresh codes, or { code, used } to show which were spent (they are struck through and read Used). With onContinue the block asks for "I have saved these codes" and keeps Continue locked until it is ticked; with onRegenerate a new set is offered behind an inline confirmation, and the new codes come back through `codes`. Print hides everything on the page except a plain sheet of the unused codes. Without onDownload the block saves recovery-codes.txt itself. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
